'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 646
|text = The cryptic reveals who to speak to:<br><br>I wouldn't wear this jean on my legs.
|notes = Speak to [[Father Jean]] in the [[Hosidius]] church.
|map = {{Map|1734,3576|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Xeric's talisman]] teleport to Xeric's Glade.
*[[Kharedst's memoirs]] or [[Book of the Dead]] teleport with [[Lunch by the Lancalliums]].
*[[Teleport to House]] with a [[player-owned house]] in [[Hosidius]], or [[Construction cape]] teleport to the Hosidius [[house portal]].
*[[Spirit tree patch]] in Hosidius, and run south-east across the bridge then north past the house portal.
*[[Fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|akr}} and run north-west.
*[[Skills necklace]] teleport to the [[Woodcutting Guild]].
*[[Kourend Castle Teleport]] and run south-east to [[Hosidius]].
